drivingQuestion: Why is a kosher animal that nursed from a tereifa disqualified?
outcomeNote: answers the מאי טעמא of the previous unit

segments.he: אֶלָּא, תָּנֵי רַבִּי חֲנִינָא טְרִיטָאָה קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כְּגוֹן שֶׁהֱנִיקָהּ חָלָב רוֹתֵחַ מִשַּׁחֲרִית לְשַׁחֲרִית, הוֹאִיל וִיכוֹלָה לַעֲמוֹד עָלֶיהָ מֵעֵת לְעֵת.
segments.en: «Rather, Rabbi Ḥanina Terita taught» the meaning of the mishna «before Rabbi Yoḥanan:» This is referring to a case «where one gave» the kosher animal «to suckle» from the tereifa «warm,» i.e., fresh, «milk every morning. Since» the kosher animal «can maintain» its existence «based upon» this suckling «for» a twenty-four-hour «period,» until the next suckling, it survives only due to the tereifa animal. Consequently, the kosher animal is prohibited to be sacrificed on the altar.
